The 0.11 development refactor keeps one product representation and ordinary
dplyr expressions while removing repeated execution choices, contract fields,
measurement calls and correction bookkeeping. Execution defaults, contract
composition and source replacement are ordinary explicit operations. Batch
measurements keep pinned evidence and expose tidy values. Infrastructure remains
optional, and business keys, time semantics and report issuance remain explicit.

Read the maintained documents for different questions:

- [Why this architecture](workflow-design.html): mental model and responsibilities.
- [Critical architecture review](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/REFACTOR_REVIEW.md): findings, decisions and remaining weaknesses.
- [Modern data stack and Ab Initio comparison](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/MODERN_DATA_STACK.md): requirements, delivered scope and gaps.
- [Validation record](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): what was actually exercised and its limits.

The package is still in development. Compatibility guarantees begin with the
first stable release candidate. Current design changes favor a smaller coherent
API over preserving experimental interfaces.
